Lord Stevens releases the results of his inquiry in the allegation of corruption in the English game, pin-pointing seventeen transfers that he will investigate further.

맨체스터 유나이티드 have increased the gap between them and 첼시, still in second place, to six points. Bolton, 리버풀, 아스널, 포츠머스 and 에버턴 complete the top seven. 왓퍼드 see in the New Year being bottom of the Premiership and ten points adrift of safety, with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 also several points behind fellow strugglers 셰필드 유나이티드, 위건 애슬레틱 and 미들즈브러. Birmingham now lead the Championship, six points ahead of Preston and 더비 카운티. Colchester have overcome a slow start to stand in sixth, behind 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. Hull, Leeds and Southend remain in the Championship drop zone.
